title: cquery fails on remote jdk repository

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

labels.name: team-Configurability
labels.description: platforms, toolchains, cquery, select(), config transitions

body:
Attempting to run cquery on the remote jdk repository (`@remotejdk11_linux`) incorrectly reports that there are no targets.

$ bazel query '@remotejdk11_linux//...'
@remotejdk11_linux//:xjc
...
$ bazel cquery '@remotejdk11_linux//...'
